absent: Locking, preemption and concurrency rules for VMCS access, PT descriptor updates and PMU state.
Full definitions and sizes of vCPU, VMCS, PT descriptor, PMU and perf switch structures beyond referenced fields.
Configuration and lifecycle of system tracing mode, mediated PMU, enlightened VMCS and CPU capability flags.
Contracts and failure modes of referenced helpers for perf, LAPIC timer, exception queueing and register availability.
Trust domain vCPU exit handling and nested virtualization interaction beyond fastpath gating.
Architectural encodings and numeric values of MSRs, VMCS fields, vectors and control bits.

findings.text: Provides dossier external control to set or clear virtual NMI blocking for a vCPU, supporting both emulated software blocking state and hardware assisted blocking state.
Provides dossier external audit that recomputes which enabled performance counters are backed by a different host physical counter and records them in a host mapping mask.
Top level VM exit dispatcher that selects confidential computing exit handling for trust domain vCPUs and standard VMX exit handling otherwise, forwarding the fastpath completion status.

Synchronous guest enter and exit wrapper executed with interrupts disabled that applies pre entry mitigations, synchronizes debug fault address, invokes low level runner, then captures exit reason and vectoring state and performs post exit NMI bookkeeping.

Low level guest transition routine that installs host stack, loads guest speculation control and general registers, selects launch versus resume, and on return saves guest registers, scrubs values, restores host speculation control and reports failure versus normal exit.

Guest exit tracing handoff is inactive in system tracing mode, otherwise when guest tracing was enabled it preserves guest tracing registers and reinstalls host tracing registers, then reinstalls host tracing control because hardware clears control on every exit.

Tracing context holds control, status, output base, output mask and filter match, plus paired address filter values per range, while the per vCPU descriptor holds separate guest and host contexts and the configured range count.

NMI blocking recovery with hardware support is skipped once unmasked state is known, otherwise it derives unblock intent and vector from exit interruption data and reasserts blocking for guest fault cases except double fault and valid vectoring delivery, else records observed unmasked state; without hardware support it accumulates software blocked duration.

Exit interruption completion clears prior injection state and queued events, and when vectoring delivery is valid it requests event processing and reestablishes NMI injection, exception with optional error code and instruction length, or interrupt queuing according to delivered type.

NMI mask state is tracked as software blocked flag with blocked time accounting when hardware support is off, and as known unmasked flag plus guest interruptibility blocking bit when hardware support is on.
VMCS bit set and clear helpers perform 32 bit read modify write through either enlightened or native accessors and statically reject 64 bit control fields.

Performance MSR atomic switching is bypassed for mediated counters, resets host cross mapping tracking, refreshes cross mapping when precise sampling is active, and for each perf provided entry either removes or programs atomic host guest switching based on value equality.

Cross mapping audit scans only counters enabled both locally and globally that have an active host event, and marks host physical indices that differ from the virtual index while ignoring unmapped events.

Guest global performance control refresh does nothing when writes are intercepted, otherwise it obtains the value from the autostore shadow and installs it into the guest field on older hardware or reads it directly from the guest field on newer hardware.

Fastpath exit dispatcher forces slow path for nested guests except preemption timer, and otherwise routes MSR writes, immediate MSR writes, preemption timer, halt and cache invalidate exits to dedicated handlers while all other reasons use the slow path.

Preemption timer fastpath absorbs spurious exits while soft disabled, reports completion when the exit was forced, defers nested guests to slow path, and otherwise expires the local APIC timer and requests immediate guest reentry.

Exit qualification is read once from hardware and cached per vCPU with a guard against trust domain use, while immediate MSR register selection is decoded from a fixed bit field of the VMX instruction information word.

Guest transition applies layered side channel defenses including conditional L1 data cache flush before entry, optional framebuffer clear suppression around entry, post exit register scrubbing, return buffer filling, speculation control restoration and branch history clearing.

L1 data flush has an active variant that honors global and conditional static controls, consumes a per CPU pending flag, accounts flushes, and uses either a dedicated flush command or a cache fill sequence, plus an empty variant for builds without the mitigation.

Framebuffer clearing suppression is a no operation unless explicitly enabled for the vCPU, otherwise entry sets a disable bit in the MCU control register and caches the value while exit clears the bit and rewrites the cached value.

Hypervisor timer programming writes zero for forced exits, otherwise derives a scaled 32 bit delta from deadline versus current cycle count when a deadline is armed, or arms a maximum value and marks soft disabled when idle; an alternate build variant statically forbids use.

Processor tracing hardware interface exposes separate registers for control, status, output base, output mask and page match, with address filters organized as paired values per range spaced by a fixed stride.

Virtualization exit interfaces expose interruption information carrying valid, vector, type, error delivery and NMI unblock indications, plus a guest interruptibility flag recording NMI blocking and vectoring fields for instruction length and error code.

Failed virtual entry is distinguished from normal exit by a nonzero runner result, recorded with a sentinel exit reason and zeroed vectoring state, while low level faults during launch or resume either report failure or fault depending on system reboot state.
